products.name: Videoleap
products.note: Mobile video editing AI; effects; templates; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
Lightricks is an Israeli AI technology company that describes itself as focused on transforming creative workflows for content creators, marketers, and professionals. Its tools span web, mobile, and open source platforms, and the company positions itself around what it calls the Open Creativity Stack, which it describes as an ecosystem of AI tools and models intended to give creators, studios, and enterprises greater speed and flexibility than closed systems allow.

The company's tracked product is Videoleap, a mobile video editing application that incorporates AI-driven effects and templates. Beyond mobile, Lightricks emphasizes open source work as a core part of its approach to building interconnected creative tools.
